description: This file defines a C# class 'Cookies' used for managing browser cookies through JavaScript interop in a Blazor application. It provides methods to get and delete cookies asynchronously.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class that facilitates cookie management via JavaScript interop in Blazor. It encapsulates JS calls to delete and retrieve cookies.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a cookie by name using JavaScript interop.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the value of a cookie by name via JavaScript interop.
